findings.evidence: Section 5 (the user's own conflict, the most common route) gives the three-column sort, one opening and the disputed-point rule, then hands off to phrase-bank.md. There is no ordered middle and close comparable to Section 3 step 4 ('Close with decision owner, criteria, and a dated checkpoint').
findings.fix: Add one closing step to Section 5 that mirrors Section 3 step 4. For example: 'Close on who does what by when and a dated check-in; read it back aloud (closing-and-followup.md), then send the Section 8 summary with disputed points marked disputed.' Keep the existing text.

findings.evidence: 'Gather each account separately first.' The warning that one-to-one accounts stay out of the joint room unless the party agrees exists only in references/facilitation.md, which loads after the gate passes. The agent gathers the separate accounts before that.
findings.fix: Add a Gotchas item to SKILL.md: '**Never carry what one party said one-to-one into the other's conversation or the joint room without their agreement.** It turns the separate accounts into evidence against them, and neither party will speak openly again; safety, harassment and policy disclosures may still have to be reported.' Leave facilitation.md step 1 in place.

findings.evidence: "files": ["evals/files/runbook-dispute-notes.md", "references/facilitation.md"]. The same pattern appears with references/delivery-scripts.md, phrase-bank.md, closing-and-followup.md, preparation-template.md and emotional-regulation.md in other evals.
findings.fix: List only user inputs (evals/files/...) under files. Passing the skill's own reference files as inputs pre-loads them, so these evals cannot catch a broken loading gate. Add an assertion where loading matters instead, for example 'the session plan uses the facts table from facilitation.md'.
